scientific_integrity: All upper-bound recoveries are supplied as explicit signed integer identities and checked by an executable standard-library program. The lower bound follows from the explicitly cited published propositions. The field-independent construction is a specialization, up to row and column scalings, of the earlier single-parity construction; only its odd-characteristic four-request all-symbol batch property and resulting exact optimum are new claims.
scientific_limitations: The exact result is restricted to four all-symbol stored-column requests, dimension four, and finite fields; the integer recovery identities actually work over arbitrary fields. It does not determine other parameters, functional batch codes, or uniqueness of the optimal generator.
title: Universal nine-column four-request all-symbol batch code in dimension four
